comment: Voices of the brand film. Every role keeps one Gemini voice in every language (the dub keeps the speaker's voice, like the product). `originals` are spoken once in their own language and shared by all film versions. Roles whose language is the viewer's language are swapped (`alt`) or dropped from that version's crowd.

film.style: soft and intimate, almost whispered, very close to the microphone; tender, a little lonely and hopeful; unhurried, with a small breath before the last question
film.srcStyle: soft and intimate, close to the microphone, tender and a little hopeful; natural conversational pace (not slow), only a short breath between the two sentences

lecture.style: calm, warm university lecturer opening a class, clear and measured

podcast.style: bright, upbeat podcast host greeting the listeners, smiling, quick

documentary.style: hushed documentary narrator full of wonder, slow and gentle

stream.style: excited gamer shouting to his team during a livestream

talkshow.style: smooth, warm television presenter opening a show

football.style: ecstatic football commentator shouting a goal

talk.style: confident speaker on a stage, warm, opening a talk
